title: Status properties/ApplyToDead
html:
See also Status properties.

ApplyToDead is a status property.

List of conditions with ApplyToDead

Condition Effects
A Most Bloody Inheritance
  • The Dread Lord Bhaal looks favourably on his chosen. You can cast  Stunning Gaze and your Critical Hit Attack Roll requirement is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.
Anointed in Splendour
  • Has a +2 bonus to all  Saving Throws.
Arcane Hunger
  • Gale's spirit is being drained. He has  Disadvantage to Constitution  Saving Throws.
Ascended Fiend
  • Raphael has gorged on souls and enhanced his fiendish powers, granting him an even deadlier array of spells and abilities. In this form,  Soul Overcharge will not prevent him from using Souls to cast spells.
Astral Gravity
  • Gravity on the Astral Plane is different than on Faerûn.
  • The affected entity is Immune to Falling damage and its Jump distance is tripled.
  • Carrying capacity is tripled.
Astrally Projected
  • While your body resides in the cold expanses of the Astral Sea, you have projected a likeness of yourself here for the evening.
Atrophied
  • One of the affected entity's Abilities has been reduced to 0, causing it to die instantly.
Aura of Hate
  • This creature and all fiends and undead within 3 m (10 ft) gain this creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their melee weapon damage.
Aura of Warding
  • The paladin and any nearby allies have Resistance to damage from spells.
Banished
  • Banished from this plane of existence.
  • Can't be targeted.
  • Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions
Blade Ward
  • Has Resistance against ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.
BOOOAL's Benediction
  •  Advantage on  Attack Rolls against  Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL.
Breathless Lungs
  • Mystic Carrion can't be  Silenced while his lungs are still intact.
Bull's Strength
  • Has  Advantage on Strength Checks.
  • Weight Limit doubled.
Castigated By Divinity
  • Affected entity is cursed by transgressed and irritable gods. When it falls unconscious, it immediately dies. Moreover, when it dies, a terrible envoy of the offended deity is conjured from the entity's corpse.
Cat's Grace
  • Has  Advantage on Dexterity Checks.
  • Only takes half damage from falling.
Curdled Liver
  • Mystic Carrion is not vulnerable to ⁠Fire damage while his liver is intact.
Disintegrating Corpse

This corpse is not long for this world.

  • The affected entity's corpse disintegrates into a pile of ash upon death.
Duel: Murder's Chosen
  • The Dark Urge is compelled to fight Orin alone. The duellists cannot be forcefully moved, and any interference from other parties will be punished.
Fetcher's Favour
  • Equipped with  Mol's tricks of the trade, affected creatures can cast  Rays of Fire, reduce all Fire damage by 5 and gain an additional 1d4 to Charisma Checks and Saving Throws.
Fungal Resurrection
  • The hag will be resurrected by nearby Pearlspore Bells at the start of their next turn.
God of Ambition
  • Mere mortals whisper petitions to the newly divine Gale Dekarios as The Once-Wizard, High Aspirant, The Lord of Zeal - but none have yet been granted an audience with the God of Ambition. Until tonight, that is.
Greater Arcane Hunger
  • The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and all  Saving Throws.
Green Bed Regeneration
  • When starting your turn on  Plant Growth Surface or  Vine Surface regain 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points.
Grotesque Distention
  • Bloated beyond hope. Will explode at the slightest touch.
  • Touching an entity affected with this condition will cause a blast of 8d6⁠⁠Poison damage in a 3 m (10 ft) radius, form a Poison Cloud of the same size, and utterly destroy the entity.
Half-Orcish Fury
  • The next time the affected entity is  Downed, it instead drops to 1 hit point thanks to the relentless will roiling in its veins.
Harm
  • Affected entity's maximum Hit Points have been reduced by the damage inflicted by the Harm spell
  • This condition is a Disease
Her Voice: the End of All
  • Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -4 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage at the end of its turn.
Her Voice: Transforming
  • Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -2 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage at the end of its turn.
Hexblade's Curse
  • Cursed by a Hexblade warlock. The warlock who cursed this entity adds their proficiency bonus to damage rolls against them. The number they need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking this entity is also reduced by 1.
Incubating

Skeletal involucre will explode on its next turn, dealing 6~27⁠⁠Necrotic damage and birthing a necromite.

Infested
  • Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1d4 Piercing damage and 1d4 Poison damage each turn.
  • When hit with a melee attack, the infestation spreads to the attacker. Upon death, the infestation spreads to all nearby creatures.
  • Removed by ⁠Fire or ⁠Acid damage.
  • Doesn't harm ettercaps or spiders.
Martial Exertion
  • Affected entity has pushed past its physical limits, taking 6d6⁠⁠Piercing damage per turn to perform an additional attack per turn and to double its movement speed.
Mind Sanctuary: Depleted
  • You cannot benefit more from Mind Sanctuary this turn.
Mobile Flourish Target
  • Targeted by a bard's fluid attack. The bard can teleport next to the creature.
Mortally Wounded
  • Can't be resurrected.
Necrotic Aura
  • Gale exudes Necrotic energy. Nearby creatures take 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic every turn.
Oath Broken
  • You have broken your sacred Oath and betrayed your beliefs. You can no longer use Channel Oath Charges.
  • You should go to camp and contemplate what happened and what comes next.
Onus of Battle
  • Affected entity can immediately use a  Reaction to make a weapon attack.
Paid the Price
  • You have a +1 bonus to Intimidation checks, but  Disadvantage on Perception checks. Additionally, you have  Disadvantage when attacking Hags.
Permanent Mind Sanctuary
  • While in combat, Mind Flayers can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
Reconfigured: Undead
  • The foulest stench is in the air...
Resonating Ki
  • The ki within the affected entity is resonating with a monk's. The monk can use  Ki Resonation: Blast to make it explode.
Sacrificed Soul
  • The affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, and attacks against it have  Advantage while the creature that sacrificed its soul is alive.
Sapping Curse

This cursed energy drains vitality of anyone who dares get closer.

  • Any creature within range of the affected entity gains the condition Vitality Drain, and takes 4d6+4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding  DC 8 Wisdom Saving Throw.
  • Target is cursed.
Severe Arcane Hunger
  • The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is severely weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and all  Saving Throws. His movement speed is halved.
Severed Soul
  • With no soul to motivate it, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and all  Ability Checks until  Restore Soul is cast on a Soul Pillar or Raphael.
Shadow Possession
  • Affected entity is possessed by frenzied shadows and will attack the nearest creature. Its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage.
Shadow-Cursed Undead
  • Those who die in the shadows are cursed to remain there forever.
  • These undead have reduced Hit Points and Strength, are Resistant to ⁠Necrotic damage and cannot use Spells or Weapon Actions.
Silenced
  • Creature can't speak or cast spells with a verbal component, and is immune to ⁠Thunder damage.
Soul Caged
  • A Soul Cage binds the Nightsong as an engine for Ketheric's Immunity to all damage.
  • The Nightsong can be  Helped out of the Soul Cage.
Soul Echo
  • While this companion's body is gone, their soul lingers on and can be used to resurrect them.
Spectral Observer
  • Though you are too dangerous to mingle in person, Withers has allowed you to observe this gathering - but only observe.
Spirit of the Land
  • The reunited soul Thaniel provides a +1 to all Ability Scores and an additional 2 m (7 ft) movement speed to all affected entities.
Spore Servant
  • The animating spores of a myconid sovereign have taken over this dead creature's body, moving it according to the sovereign's will.
  • Resurrected creature is classified as a plant.
  • Immune to all  Frightened conditions,  Blinded conditions,  Befuddled,  Charmed,  Crown of Madness,  Friends,  Hideous Laughter,  Hold Person,  Mind Mastery, Noxious Fumes (Bibberbang), Paralysed, and  Sleeping.
  • Creature is resistant to ⁠Poison damage.
  • Creature is unable to cast spells or wild shape.
Tharchiate Withering
  • Your Constitution score is reduced by 5 while cursed by The Tharchiate Codex's warped arcana.
Thoughtless Brain
  • Mystic Carrion's spells have a +3 bonus to their Difficulty Class and he can't be  Surprised while his brain is intact.
Umbral Influx
  • Tendrils of shadow engulf the corpse, until it becomes unclear where the body ends and the shadows begin.
Unbeating Heart
  • Carrion's undying life force is stored outside of his body - if killed while his heart is intact, he will rise again the next day.
Unrelenting Storm
  • The next time this creature would be reduced to 0 hit points, it will instead remain conscious with 1 hitpoint left.
  • In addition, it will begin  Hoarding Energy, gain  100 temporary hit points for 1 round and lose any Incapacitating Conditions.
Volo's Guide to Monsters
  • With steadfast application of knowledge from Volo's preeminent work, affected entitites gain +2 to Attack Rolls, Saving Throws and Ability Checks.
Weavewalker
  • One must remove all obstacles to follow one's destiny -  Arabella's favour grants affected creatures the benefits of  Freedom of Movement.
  • The affected creature's Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain, spells or magical effects.
  • The affected creature cannot be  Paralysed or  Restrained.
Welcome Spectre
  • Withers has plucked your spirit briefly from beyond the grave to observe this party - but only observe.
Wound Closure
  • While unconscious, the affected entity stabilises at the start of its turn.
